newsitem.title: USA: Washington Thanksgiving data dates moved.
newsitem.headline: Washington Thanksgiving data dates moved.

text.p: The following is a roundup of issue dates for weekly reports that normally come out on Thursdays but will be disrupted by the Thanksgiving Day holiday on Nov 28 (times EST/GMT):
- Labour Dept, weekly jobless (0830/1330, Wed, Nov 27)
- Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp, weekly mortgage rates (after 1230/1730, Wed, Nov 27)
- Assoc. of American Railroads, rail car loadings (after 1400/1900, Wed, Nov 27)
- Investment Company Institute, weekly money market fund data (after 1700/2200, Wed, Nov 27)
- National Oilseed Processors Assoc. said its weekly soybean crushings data will be delayed to Monday, Dec. 2.
